notes.title: ✨ HELP US CREATE AN ARTBOOK ✨
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/19ea2e323b6e7f5ec5e4c9a7a3a5feea3a2b51ea.png[/img]

Hey there, friends!

Thank you for being with us through this awesome journey so far. We've launched [b][url=https://t.me/furlough_games]our Telegram channel[/url][/b] last week and there are lots of people already chatting with us! 

We've been thinking of new ways to treat you lately, and one of the ideas that stuck with us was making [i][b]a digital art book[/b][/i] - a collection of the best artworks and the process of their creation bound together into a neat PDF. 

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39402905/6fd8bd68f109e5b4f502ebcbf63aa014ab9767d8.png[/img]

[b]We've created a poll in our Telegram channel[/b], and we encourage you to vote for the games you'd love to see an art book of. 

You can cast multiple votes - and help us decide sooner✨

[i]We're still hosting a giveaway on our Telegram channel, so don't forget to claim your key there![/i]

That's all for now!
